statements.status_notes: Apache Airflow 3.3.2 restricts the /assets/events API, including its count and pagination, to asset events from Dags the caller may read (https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/71741, backported to the 3.3 line in https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/71785; announcement https://lists.apache.org/thread/rx5lg86l0qkjl2s7dtmpqxjq0xplr4fy). Each of the 110 airflow packages published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository (3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-14, amd64 and arm64) was placed by what it installs, read from the package's own file list and md5sums: 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.0-3 install apache-airflow-core 3.3.0 and 3.3.1-0 to 3.3.1-15 install 3.3.1, and lack the fix; 3.3.2-0 to 3.3.2-19 install 3.3.2 and 3.4.0-0 to 3.4.0-14 install 3.4.0. In the unpacked 3.3.2-0 and 3.4.0-0 packages, airflow/api_fastapi/core_api/security.py defines PermittedAssetEventFilter and routes/public/assets.py applies it to the asset events query; it is absent from the unpacked 3.3.0-0 and 3.3.1-1 packages. Every other build's copy of those files has the same md5 as the unpacked build of its Airflow release, on both architectures. 3.3.2-0 is the first published package with the fix.
